verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state that agents can update statuses, add comments, link PRs to issues, and create new tasks across Jira, Linear, ClickUp and Monday.com. They also document a Linear workspace connection, ClickUp task creation, and an integrations endpoint listing OAuth integrations for Linear, ClickUp, Jira and Monday.com. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and per-tracker depth for Jira and Monday.com beyond the summary claims.
